concept.name: Test set
concept.definition: A final held-out sample used once to estimate performance after model and hyperparameter choices are fixed.
concept.intuition: It estimates how a fitted choice behaves on observations that were not used to fit that choice.
concept.mechanics: Lock the pipeline first, apply it without refitting to the test observations, and report all prespecified metrics and costs.
concept.failure_modes: Random splitting, overlapping labels, repeated tuning, or an unprotected final test set can produce optimistic estimates.
concept.misconceptions: Validation measures conditional generalization under a split design; it does not guarantee future market performance.
concept.example: After choosing depth on 2021 validation data, the frozen model is evaluated once on 2022-2023 test data.
